status: AUTHOR ONLY; root full-read precedes one offline execution. No BI4 decoding, build, solver, production edit, SHA or Git.
inputs: Require existing passed CPU r2 reader completion; original typed22 header/layout/file size, initial time0,7060 aligned IDs and native_ids initial coordinates are checked. Read only the first frame. The execution XML supplies actual float mass/h/rho constants, and native soil current V is checked against V0=double(float(MassFluid))/rho0 times J. No existing decoder is started and no later four frames are analyzed.
primary_reference: Lian2021 seepage PDF page9 Eq33/34 and page21 Eq68. Eq68 is sum_j Vj*Wij<.95, with no explicit j!=i. The surrounding text does not specify wall/self membership of N sufficiently to claim a unique exact mapping to this mixed mDBC geometry. Report four combinations: soil-only versus soil+fixed-wall quadrature, each with/without self. Do not fit threshold or silently select the combination closest to current labels.
kernel_volume: Same2D Cubic expression and float pointwise constants/operations as FunSphKernel.h, h=double(float(.048)); actual double native positions, float rr2 support cutoff and double summation in native-ID order. This is an offline Eq68 diagnostic, not a bit-equivalent CPU/GPU kernel test. Actual V0 is from mass/rho, not ideal dp^2. Wall-source volume is V0*actual wall J as in current production FS; fixed saved PoroCurrentVolume0 is a marker, not physical zero quadrature.
regions: All5000 soil plus overlapping distance<=2h bands to true leftx0/rightx4/bedz0/topz2 and four corner intersections; interior outside all bands. Retain native FSType counts including classes not2/3. These diagnostic bands do not infer wetness, contact or eligibility of wall samples.
outputs: tests/figures/upl_c08_fsmask_r1.csv:5000 rows, four support sums/masks/current class and location bands
tests/figures/upl_c08_fsmask_r1.check.json:material, ranges, original counts and per-region confusion counts
scope: Initial mask compatibility only. No new detector, boundary implementation, threshold, pressure reset, solver admission, five-frame transient analysis or physical acceptance. Existing accepted controls are untouched. Fresh output prefix is required; partial/failure artifacts are retained rather than overwritten.
